title: skills install/diff: .claude/skills + .agent/skills targets, user and project scope
description:
Human decision (2026-08-12, refined): the installer is DETECTION-FIRST against the current repo. The two conventions .claude/skills and .agent/skills cover ~99% of harnesses; instead of target flags, `tk skills install <name>` (run inside a repo) checks the repo root for `.claude/skills/` and `.agent/skills/` and installs into EVERY one that exists — both when both exist, each getting the full tree + stamp via the existing atomic-swap path with the existing unmanaged-refusal/--force semantics applied per target.

Extend tk skills install/diff (read cmd/tk/cmd/skills*.go + internal/skills first; preserve every existing behavior):

1. Default (no flags): detect at the repo root (resolve the root the way other commands do). Install into every detected convention dir. Report each target on its own line. If NEITHER exists: error (exit 4 semantics are wrong here — use 1) with a message listing the two conventions and the --dir escape (`create .claude/skills/ or .agent/skills/ at the repo root, or pass --dir`). Never silently create a convention dir the repo has not opted into.
2. `--dir PATH` unchanged: explicit single target, no detection.
3. `tk skills diff <name>`: same detection; diff EVERY detected install, one report each; overall exit 1 if any target drifts, 0 only when all detected targets match. --dir single-target unchanged.
4. Outside a repo with no --dir: same neither-exists error message (mention running inside a repo).
5. Help text documents detection-first behavior compactly. ResetFlags for any new flag vars; registration discipline per .tick/learnings.md if new files.
6. Tests (temp repos only): claude-only repo installs one; agent-only installs one; both installs both (each stamped, each independently diffable); neither -> error with guidance; per-target unmanaged refusal (one managed + one unmanaged: managed succeeds, unmanaged refused, exit reflects the refusal); diff aggregate exit contract; --dir bypasses detection.
7. Update the README Skills section lines the docs tick wrote ONLY where behavior changed (detection-first sentence + flag rows); keep edits minimal.

Full-suite gate on real exit codes per .tick/config.md Testing; gofmt/vet clean. Commit with message prefix "tick hzd: ".
acceptance_criteria: Detection-first: claude-only/agent-only/both/neither cells pinned by tests incl. per-target refusal and aggregate diff exit; --dir bypass unchanged; README updated minimally; full suite green
